title: JSFL: fl.clipCopyFrames and fl.clipPasteFrames stubs missing
description: The fl object in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts (makeFlProxy ~line 1345) does not expose clipCopyFrames() or clipPasteFrames(). In Flash 8 JSFL these copy/paste clip properties (position, scale, rotation, alpha, filters, blendMode etc.) across keyframes — different from frame-clipboard operations. Fix: add clipCopyFrames(startFrame, endFrame, keyframeArray) and clipPasteFrames(startFrame, keyframeArray) stubs to both the JsflFl interface and the proxy. For now, stubs can log a warning and return undefined. Priority: low.
